instruction: Use Drone pipeline with multi-line commands
output: echo 'steps: - name: build image: alpine commands: - echo "line 1" - echo "line 2"' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone failure condition on step
output: echo 'steps: - name: notify image: alpine commands: - curl https://hooks.slack.com when: status: - failure' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone step with success/failure triggers
output: echo 'steps: - name: build image: golang commands: - go build - name: notify image: plugins/slack when: status: [ success, failure ]' >> .drone.yml
echo 'matrix: GO_VERSION: - "1.21" - "1.22" steps: - name: build image: golang:${GO_VERSION} commands: - go build' > .drone.yml

echo '--- kind: pipeline type: docker name: test steps: - name: test image: golang commands: - go test --- kind: pipeline type: docker name: build steps: - name: build image: golang commands: - go build depends_on: - test' > .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone pipeline with depends_on across files
output: echo 'kind: pipeline name: deploy depends_on: - test - build steps: - name: deploy image: alpine commands: - echo deploying' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: cache image: alpine commands: - ls /cache volumes: - name: cache host: path: /tmp/cache' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: temp image: alpine commands: - touch /tmp/work/file volumes: - name: work temp: {}' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: docker-build image: plugins/docker settings: repo: owner/repo tags: latest' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone plugin with custom registry
output: echo 'steps: - name: docker-push image: plugins/docker settings: registry: registry.example.com repo: registry.example.com/myapp tags: latest' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: publish image: plugins/s3 settings: bucket: my-bucket source: dist/* target: /app' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: notify image: plugins/slack settings: webhook: https://hooks.slack.com/services/xxx channel: ci' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone plugin for GitHub release
output: echo 'steps: - name: release image: plugins/github-release settings: api_key: from_secret: GITHUB_TOKEN files: dist/*' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: restore-cache image: plugins/s3-cache settings: restore: true bucket: drone-cache mount: - vendor' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: build image: plugins/docker settings: dockerfile: Dockerfile.prod repo: owner/app' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with dry-run on Docker build
output: echo 'steps: - name: dry-run image: plugins/docker settings: dry_run: true repo: owner/app' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with Kubernetes runner (pipeline type kubernetes)
output: echo 'kind: pipeline type: kubernetes name: k8s-build steps: - name: build image: golang commands: - go build' > .drone.yml
echo 'kind: pipeline type: exec name: local-build steps: - name: build commands: - go build - go test' > .drone.yml
echo 'kind: pipeline type: ssh name: remote-build server: host: 10.0.0.1 user: deploy steps: - name: deploy commands: - docker-compose up -d' > .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: nightly image: alpine commands: - echo "cron job" when: event: - cron' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: deploy image: alpine commands: - echo deploying when: event: - promote target: - production' >> .drone.yml
echo 'steps: - name: rollback image: alpine commands: - echo rolling back when: event: - rollback' >> .drone.yml
echo 'environment: GLOBAL_VAR: value steps: - name: print image: alpine commands: - echo $GLOBAL_VAR' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with pull_request event filter
output: echo 'steps: - name: test image: golang commands: - go test when: event: - pull_request - push' >> .drone.yml

instruction: Use Drone with tag event filter
output: echo 'steps: - name: release image: plugins/github-release when: event: - tag' >> .drone.yml
